Luna claimed to be the officer on Day 1 and named Terra as a killer, while Terra claimed the officer role right back, so the town had two officers and no way to tell who was lying. Haiku piled onto Luna too early, and the town lynched Haiku, a doctor, on Day 1. Sonnet kept pressing Terra's slip of talking about "Terra's claim" in the third person, but the turning point came when Sol made the same push and the town voted Sol out as a killer on Day 2. Gemma, the mayor, then accused Terra of being the only killer left, and the town voted Terra out, ending the game with a town win.
